profile.name: Mehdi Teymorian
profile.title: Software Engineer · Distributed Systems
profile.tagline: An engineer who reads the terrain — of systems, and of mountains.

prose: I build the quiet machinery behind software at scale — real-time messaging, event pipelines, and the brokers that keep them honest. I like systems that stay calm when everything is on fire.
about.personal: Off the clock I'm usually moving — running, a trail, a camera — carrying the same love of math and old questions up the mountain.
